subject.title: Feature Request: Add parseMode config for Telegram channels

question: Should Telegram expose a public channel/account text-format mode, and if so should it support only safe formatted-versus-plain output or also MarkdownV2/raw HTML semantics?
rationale: Transporting a selected mode through the code is bounded, but the permanent config contract, trust model, inheritance, and compatibility default cannot be safely chosen from implementation evidence alone.

options.title: Safe two-mode selector
options.body: Add inherited formatted-versus-plain behavior, preserve rendered HTML as the default, and exclude raw HTML and MarkdownV2 from this first contract.

options.title: Full Telegram modes
options.body: Expose plain, HTML, and MarkdownV2 only with explicit escaping, trusted-input semantics, documentation, and upgrade proof for every outbound funnel.

options.title: Keep current policy
options.body: Retain standard HTML delivery plus the existing rich-message opt-in and decline another configuration surface.

recommendation.title: Safe two-mode selector
recommendation.body: Add inherited formatted-versus-plain behavior, preserve rendered HTML as the default, and exclude raw HTML and MarkdownV2 from this first contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the HTML policy and merged the later compatibility/default decision, making him the strongest available owner for the product contract.
